description.value: OHM Electric Bikes is a Canadian e-bike manufacturer and retailer that has designed bikes in North Vancouver since 2005, operating an Experience Center there for sales, service, and test rides. The shop stocks new, open-box, and certified pre-owned OHM e-bikes, and its technicians are Bosch and Shimano STEPS certified. Touring cyclists will find a full-service e-bike workshop backed by the brand's own engineers, plus access to mobile service across the Lower Mainland through a partnership with Nootka Bike Co.

address.value: 930 Harbourside Dr #103, North Vancouver, BC V7P 3S7, Canada
